about_the_game:
The FUTURE SAGA Pack Set bundles together FUTURE SAGA Chapter 1-4! This pack set is jammed full of content to enjoy DRAGON BALL XENOVERSE 2 even more, including Extra Missions with characters active in new forms, new Parallel Quests, Additional Moves, Costumes, and more!

FUTURE SAGA Chapter 1
• 5 New Playable Characters: Vegeta (Super Saiyan God, Ultra Supervillain), Goku Black (Super Saiyan Rosé, Ultra Supervillain), Broly (Restrained), Android 18 (DB Super), Videl (DB Super)
• 3 Extra Missions
• 12 Parallel Quests
• 15 Additional Moves
• 3 Costumes/Accessories
• 5 Super Souls
• 63 Illustrations

FUTURE SAGA Chapter 2
• 3 New Playable Characters: Jiren (Full Power, Ultra Supervillain), Belmod, Goku (Mini)
• 1 Extra Missions Arc
• 4 Parallel Quests
• 7 Additional Moves
• 2 Costumes/Accessories
• 3 Super Souls
• 14 Illustrations

FUTURE SAGA Chapter 3
• 2 New Playable Characters: Golden Frieza (Ultra Supervillain), Broly (DB Super)
• 1 Extra Missions Arc
• 3 Parallel Quests
• 6 Additional Moves
• 5 Costumes/Accessories
• 3 Super Souls
• 23 Illustrations
• 1 Extra Scenario: Cheelai & Broly All Out! Conton City Patrol

FUTURE SAGA Chapter 4
• A new Playable Character and more!

*Future Saga Chapter DLCs can be purchased separately. Please take care to avoid duplicate purchases.
*Some of the above contents can be obtained by clearing certain conditions in the game.
*Content will be available by 9/30/2026.
